acceptance_criteria: CI deploys through a reusable Pages workflow only after the test job passed and only for a push to main; pull requests and other branches never deploy; a manual run deploys only on main
The deploy workflow checks out the commit that triggered it without a ref override and without a dependency cache
The script-tag check in the tests matches tags in any letter case and still requires exactly the two expected scripts
CodeQL reports no alert on the pull request
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: The app is deployed to GitHub Pages only after the CI tests passed on a push to main, without any CodeQL alert.
